summary: Most consequential: the neck-pain Urgent rule and its check_for drop 'x-ray unavailable' from 'Recent injury and x-ray unavailable/abnormal', so a recently injured neck with no x-ray (the usual primary-care case) and no neuro symptoms is not made Urgent and does not get immobilised. Lesser issues: carpal tunnel evidence loses 'worse at night'/'relieved by shaking', thumb pain worse with wrist movement is encoded as wrist-site pain, and 'unable to do all actions comfortably' is narrowed to limitation of movement. Everything else, including meningitis, fracture, stroke/TIA, joint problem, referred pain and elbow rules and both priority structures, matches the page; the non-urgent neck-pain risk-factor branch (>50 y, steroids, HIV etc.) has no rule, which is acceptable as it names no diagnosis.
